evidence.title: Mimestream | A native macOS email client for Gmail

name: Mimestream
summary: Native macOS email client for Gmail built on the Gmail API: labels, filters, snooze, templates, multiple accounts and tracking prevention.
description: A native macOS client for Gmail that connects to the Gmail API directly rather than through an intermediary sync service. Handles multiple Google accounts with profiles, unified inbox, working hours and Focus filters, plus inbox categories, colored labels, filters, search, snooze, vacation responses and tracking prevention. Composing adds aliases, templates with variables, send and archive, undo send, and markdown with code blocks. Subscription after a 14-day free trial.
contains: native macOS client built on the Gmail API; macOS 12 Monterey or newer
triage: inbox categories, colored labels, filters, list filtering, Gmail-backed search
snooze labs, vacation responses, tracking prevention for 75+ services
multiple accounts with profiles, unified inbox, working hours and Focus filters
compose: aliases, templates with variables, send and archive, undo send, markdown and code
built for Apple Silicon; menu bar extra, swipe gestures, image markup, multiple windows
pricing: $49.99/year or $4.99/month, up to 5 devices, family sharing; group licenses per seat
14-day free trial without a credit card; founded 2019, bootstrapped team of 5
